chapter: Second reel: instrument, style and wrap-up
title: His first guitar, a cheap one bought by his father
summary: Nelson's first guitar was a cheap, funny little instrument his father brought him in the country at age eight, and his small hand could only finger half of it.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: What kind of, when you first got a guitar, what kind of an instrument was it?
It was a little tin pan, a little funny little guitar. Cheap, that was cheap.
Remember where you got it or what you paid for?
Well my father brought it to me.
He just brought it to you? Yeah.
He came up here and he brought it down to the country to me. How old were you about then?
Eight years old. Eight years old. Yeah. Pretty small because your hand reached it as a regular big guitar?
Yeah it was a big guitar. I used to finger, you know, half. Yeah. I didn't have to finger all the way I finger would go, as much as I could.
